summary: This is a 6-K filing by ChipMOS Technologies, a Taiwanese semiconductor company, reporting its financial results under a TWSE triggering event. The filing was submitted on July 30, 2026, and includes unaudited data for May 2026 and Q1 2026, showing revenue of NT$2,384M (+17.7% YoY) and EPS of NT$0.30. No corporate event, transaction, or strategic action is involved. This is routine periodic financial disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or board actions are discussed. It informs investors of current performance but creates no actionable event or arbitrage opportunity.
